description: Rewrite every 'name :: type' in a pattern under fixtures/, fixtures2/, guides/ and tests/ (bitstring segment specs stay). A typed parameter that picks a clause becomes a guard (x :: integer -> when is_integer(x)); 'x :: any' is dropped; a tuple or struct shape becomes a pattern; a declaration-only annotation becomes or stays an @spec. Prediction: every expected output and every pin is unchanged, because a guard type test and a parameter annotation become the same Region::Type question (dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs add_row). A fixture whose subject is the annotation itself (a ParamAnnotation diagnostic, annotation-specific dispatch) is listed for decision, not rewritten. A fixture that becomes valid Elixir and whose output Elixir agrees with may be made an oracle fixture. Acceptance: full gate green, no pin change.
title: Fixtures, guides and tests state types with guards and @spec, not '::' in patterns
